failure.message: The API failed closed because the qualification Compose process did not receive OPENAI_API_KEY from the repository-root environment.
failure.root_cause: The ignored qualified runtime file intentionally contains no credential, while the launch command sourced only that file and did not preserve the separately stored root credential for Compose interpolation.
failure.correction_boundary: Load the repository-root credential into the process environment without printing or copying it, then source the non-secret qualified selectors and start a fresh stack. No product method, source, profile, gate, image source, or qualification check may change.

decision: Invalid execution; preserve the failed-closed result and permit one environment-only corrective attempt with the credential passed in memory.
